turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm finally starting a proper strength program and there are so many styles to choose from.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me walk you through all the options, then you can tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Full body workouts three times a week, hitting every muscle each time with a few big lifts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A push, pull and legs split, which means going five or six days a week to do it properly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Bodyweight training at home, like push-ups, pull-ups and lunges, with no equipment at all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a beginner, the full body routine is hard to beat, three sessions is manageable and you practice the main lifts often. The split works better once you're more experienced and have more time. Bodyweight training is great if the gym is the obstacle.
